verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's updates changelog gives dated advance notice of model-name retirement. It announced that `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner` will be discontinued in three months (2026-07-24) and mapped those aliases to current modes during the transition. This is a per-event notice, not a standing deprecation policy, and the evidence shows no explicit API versioning scheme beyond model releases. missing for 10: a formal written deprecation policy (guaranteed notice windows, support periods), explicit API version identifiers or pinning, independent corroboration that deprecations follow the announced timeline.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The two legacy API model names, `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner`, will be discontinued in three months (2026-07-24).
During the current period, these two model names point to the non-thinking mode and thinking mode
